title: Super Mario Mash-Up: Nabbit killer bunny Addition
description: This pack replaces the Killer Bunny's texture with that of the iconic Super Mario character Nabbit!
body:
![The new killer rabbit texture in this pack, representing the character Nabbit from Super Mario, alongside several normal rabbids](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d93d28d3318b861907f0b81c62cfd3f82cb1ea3.png)This pack transforms the rare and dangerous Killer Bunny into Nabbit from the Super Mario universe.

Instead of the standard killer bunny now you have Nabbit! A rabbit that was intended to replace the Killer Bunny—but couldn't be included in the original pack because it doesn't exist in Bedrock—has now been brought to life; I created its texture using the new rabbit model, so you can enjoy it and its baby variant!

Recommendation:
For the ultimate experience, i highly recommend using this texture alongside the official Super Mario Mash-Up Pack to make Nabbit fit seamlessly into your world.

Credits
Original Textures & Inspiration: Full credits to 4J Studios for their incredible work on the original Super Mario Mash-Up Pack textures and chillyroll for porting the original package to the Java version.
